g.text: Lower sampling: which recursive work shrinks, and which grows?
Two graphs × two sampler seeds per case; the four realizations share graphs. Counts include all recursive calls.
Eight fields selected before diagnostic results; all 65 remain in the tables. Zero ratios and undefined denominators are annotated, not plotted on the log axis.
These are different logical events, not CPU instructions or additive time costs. Instrumented durations are excluded.
